articles.summary: Conference Call to be Held at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on February 25, 2026 Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit” or the “company”) (NYSE: PRSU), announced today that it plans to release financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025 after market close on Wednesday, February 25, 2026 and will host a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day to review its financial results and provide business updates. A live audio webcast of the call will be available in listen-only mode through the "Events Presentations" section of Pursuit’s website, where the company will also post its earnings press release and an earnings presentation prior to the call. The live call can also be accessed by dialing (646) 844-6383 or (833) 470-1428 and entering the access code 736154.
